fields.decision: Select the compatible parser and validation contract or reject the artifact.
Correlate one interpretation with its validation, requirements, and trace.
Load and verify the exact RawIntent interpreted by the compiler.
Create requirements for every user goal and reject dropped goals.
Compile promised results and help the planner distinguish a direct answer from artifact or action work.
Choose the general result shape: information, artifact, or action.
Preserve explicit scope, content, limits, prohibitions, preferences, format, and temporal boundaries.
Distinguish required, prohibited, limited, and preferred behavior.
Generate deterministic coverage checks for structured values instead of reparsing prose.
Recover the exact RawIntent text supporting each normalized statement.
Clarify blocking uncertainty or compile non-blocking uncertainty into a disclosed requirement.
Admit or stop the request before requirement compilation.
Block mutually incompatible instructions until resolved.
Create discovery requirements rather than invent unavailable facts.
Verify inferred items are traceable to grounded IntentIR items.

lifecycle_fields.decision: Reject unregistered checks and select the artifact-specific verifier.
Require a registered check or an explicit evaluator-judged scope disposition.
Admit or reject planned and dispatched effects.
Determine whether work answers directly, reuses, changes, composes, generates, clarifies, or rejects.
Reject graph growth not justified by a real obligation.
Resolve the typed implementation contract for each logical node.
Validate compatible operators and rank dispatch-time fallbacks.
Prove acyclicity and calculate readiness.
Validate every edge and hand downstream nodes content-addressed inputs.
Assign requirement ownership without weakening requirements.
Forbid ungated nodes and select the registered gate.
Freeze only accepted plans; otherwise authorize one bounded repair.
Locate owners, artifacts, and verifiers for every obligation.
Reject runtime reads whose content no longer matches the frozen contract.
Select ready work and recover without changing PlanIR.
Launch the selected operator and explain every skipped alternative.
Accept only the current owner and safely requeue expired attempts.
Classify a typed result without reading stdout or log text.
Verify the exact outputs before gating or downstream use.
Pass only when both independent decisions accept the same generation.
Exclude blocked operators and select the next viable alternative.
Determine the final run truth and mechanically block false green.
Publish the execution and verification boundary without hiding uncertainty.
Prevent memory or failed runs from silently becoming approved workflows.

rejection_rule: Reject any proposed semantic field that drives no consumer decision or integrity check.
